explanation: Bodies 1 (m=6.75) and 4 (m=15.69) fall into a deep close encounter (distance 0.33 at step 8 shrinking to 0.14 at step 9, below softening 0.3). Acceleration and velocity spike (body 1 speed 6.6->8.28). The integrator uses fixed dt=0.0293 with only 6 substeps_in_step at steps 8 and 9, so the rapidly varying strong force during periapsis is under-resolved by leapfrog, causing a sudden non-physical energy jump from -68.9 to -86.1 exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing dt alone removes the violation.
